title: HudPayload
description: The contract between the Rule Layer (JINI/coach-core) and the HUD Module (Cockpit Presentation Layer). This is the ONLY permitted data crossing from Rule Layer to HUD. No persona, no narrative, no JINI identity.

schema_version.description: Schema version — must match at runtime. Mismatch = hard error.

session_id.description: Opaque session identifier from WorkspaceEngine. HUD does not interpret this — passes through for audit only.

trigger.description: What caused this HUD to appear.

severity.description: Aggregate severity — the highest severity across all findings. Drives the Stepped Pulse animation and dismiss rules.

findings.description: The CoachFindings subset relevant to this HUD display. Read-only. HUD never modifies these.

context.description: Session context tags — read from PFR state, passed through Rule Layer. HUD displays these as context badges, not as business logic.

actions.description: Optional. Actionable items the user can take. If absent, HUD is display-only.

lifecycle.description: Optional. Overrides default lifecycle rules for this specific payload.

source.description: rule_engine: auto-triggered by severity >= high. user_request: manual trigger (Show Details). re_ingest: new ingest event replaced prior findings.

kind.description: auto = rule_engine triggered. manual = user_request or re_ingest.

finding_id.description: Optional. If triggered by a specific finding (e.g. true_peak_exceeded), the finding ID that caused the trigger.

id.description: Finding ID from Rule Engine. Maps 1:1 to CoachFindings issue IDs.

params.description: Numeric context for this finding. HUD displays these values — never interprets them.

guidance_key.description: Optional. Lookup key into a static guidance strings table. HUD resolves this to a short deterministic string. NOT narrative. NOT persona.

input_mode.description: Read from PFR state. HUD displays as context badge only — 'A/B DETECTED' etc.

id.description: Action identifier. Cockpit dispatches this ID as an event — never interprets the action itself.

label.description: Short display label. e.g. 'Apply Fix', 'Dismiss', 'Show Details'.

kind.description: dismiss = always available. primary = highlighted action. secondary = supporting action.

resolves_finding_id.description: Optional. If this action resolves a specific finding, the finding ID. State change lives in Rule Layer — HUD only fires the event.

auto_dismiss_ms.description: Optional. Auto-dismiss timeout in milliseconds. Only valid for severity info or low. For medium: optional, for high: MUST be absent (no auto-dismiss).

persist_until_resolved.description: If true, HUD stays visible until the finding is marked resolved by Rule Layer. Default true for high severity.
